critical_code_review_comments: Multiple internal /admin/* endpoints return 404 despite JWT with is_admin=true — either they're intentionally dropped in the prod router bundle or the route list drifted. Recommend a small e2e smoke test hitting each admin endpoint per deploy to catch missing mounts.

Chat streaming already emits rich telemetry (mode, intent, confidence, gateway_ms, council_recalled) — surface this on-screen behind a debug flag for founders; currently only visible by inspecting the SSE payload.

Cross-pod scan cache contract (tree_sha in mermaid response) is good, but codebase-health scan didn't return the tree_sha in its 502 response body — worth surfacing on 502 too so client-side cache can still short-circuit.
